$schema_note: Not a real JSON Schema; documents the contract for humans/xUnit.
description: Buckets a GCP `compute instances create` failure's stderr text into a taxonomy bucket. Extracted from the DNA-Entropy-Genbank prototype (commit 8026bf5c4afbe3021c1f7e79a17a93af4eaad84b) before its cloud/ package was gutted from the worker package (issue #280/#277). Reproduces `dna_entropy.cloud.gcloud.classify_create_error(stderr: str) -> str` for a future C# `DnaEntropyGraph.Core.ErrorCatalog`/structured-error classifier (see docs/migration/2026-09-19-worker-migration-inventory.md, 'cloud/gcloud.py — GCP wrapper surface').
matching_notes: Matching is case-insensitive substring matching on stderr.lower(); buckets are checked in a fixed priority order (see 'evaluation_order').
billing is checked before quota because some billing errors also mention the word 'account'.
'other' is the fallback when no bucket's conditions match.

bucket_conditions.billing: 'billing' in s AND ('enable' in s OR 'disabled' in s OR 'not found' in s OR 'not active' in s OR 'account' in s)
bucket_conditions.api_disabled: 'has not been used in project' in s OR 'accessnotconfigured' in s OR 'serviceusage' in s OR ('compute' in s AND 'api' in s AND ('disabled' in s OR 'not enabled' in s)) OR 'it is disabled' in s
bucket_conditions.stockout: 'stockout' in s OR 'zone_resource_pool_exhausted' in s OR 'does not have enough resources' in s OR 'resource_availability' in s
bucket_conditions.already_exists: 'already exists' in s OR 'resource already exists' in s
bucket_conditions.permission: 'permission' in s OR 'forbidden' in s OR 'not authorized' in s OR 'iam' in s
bucket_conditions.network: 'could not reach' in s OR 'connection' in s OR 'network is unreachable' in s OR 'timed out' in s OR 'timeout' in s
